title.zh: 伊朗称海峡有7艘船只遭袭，警告美国可能面临更大规模的回应
title.en: 伊朗称海峡有7艘船只遭袭，警告美国可能面临更大规模的回应

current_state.zh: Iran's Revolutionary Guard said four tankers engaged in illicit oil transfers in the northern Persian Gulf were hit and set ablaze and three further vessels struck mines west of the Strait of Hormuz, while warning the US that continued provocation could trigger a larger attack on its regional bases.
